title: Design #5893: CI tiering for adversarial and benchmark suites
body: Real-and-current design issue #5893. Define smoke/scheduled/soak tiers, time budgets, and environment guards for the adversarial and benchmark suites. Keep final budgets aligned with the shared generator, baseline, and scenario catalogue decisions in #5891, #5894, and #5892.

issue.title: id: design: CI tiering for adversarial & benchmark suites (from #5685)

payload.problem: Issue #5893 remains open as an active design decision: define CI tiers (smoke / scheduled / soak), time budgets, and environment guards for the adversarial and benchmark suites. On current main, id-bench is a manually dispatched, 60-minute, non-blocking full run; the adversarial suite is an in-process refusal test suite, not a tiered load-test workflow. Parent #5685 is open; the child design tickets #5891, #5892, and #5894 are also open.
evidence: Fresh GitHub read 2026-11-08: #5893 is OPEN and has no held, user/owned, do-not-merge, or do-not-auto-edit labels.
Fresh GitHub read 2026-11-08: parent #5685 is OPEN; the scope remains a separate CI-tiering design decision.
Open-PR title search for 'CI tiering' returned no results; a broad search for 5893 found only open PR #3965, whose body says it implements issue #3950 and is unrelated.

Current main .github/workflows/id-bench.yml:9-17,23-25,38-40 runs manually via workflow_dispatch, has a 60-minute timeout, and is explicitly non-blocking; it does not define smoke/scheduled/soak tiers or environment guards.
Current main .github/ci-policy.md:154-164 classifies id bench as no-PR/full-main; pkgs/id/tests/world_dos.rs:1-36 is a consolidated in-process refusal suite and not a tiered CI load-test design.
acceptance: Record a decision on #5893 (or a doc/ record linked from it) that defines smoke/scheduled/soak tiers, time budgets, and environment guards against shared or production targets.
State the chosen shape, rejected alternatives and reasons, and implementation invariants; align with parent #5685 without silently changing its decisions.
Defer final tier contents and budgets until #5891/#5894/#5892 settle the shared generator, standard baseline, and scenario catalogue; make dependencies explicit.
Close #5893 with a closing keyword once the decision record lands.

exclude: Re-doing work already landed in the listed PRs

tests: Verify against current main; no runtime reproduction needed — this is a design deliverable.
